description: Round stylized cat with short hindlimbs, an oversized head including ears, rounded paws and an attached long tail. Clothing is optional; visible anatomy remains feline.

seams.head_body: A scarf may conceal a neck overlap. Gaps, exposed neck plates and obvious deformation fail. Report overlap concealment instead of claiming a welded surface.
seams.tail_body: A small overlap may conceal the tail root. The tail must remain attached in every reviewed pose; report separate topology honestly.

motion_semantics.shoulder_raise: Bilateral forelimb raise for shoulder attachment and deformation inspection.
motion_semantics.elbow_bend: Forelimb bend for elbow deformation inspection.
motion_semantics.knee_bend: Biped hindlimb bend for knee deformation inspection.
motion_semantics.paw_curl: Soft grouped paw squeeze toward the observed palm; no opposing thumb is required.
motion_semantics.cheer: Restrained biped cheer with soft paw squeeze and optional tail wag.
motion_semantics.tail_wag: Optional attached tail-chain wag; inspect root and curved surface stability.

criteria: recognizable round cat rather than a human body with a cat head
head and ears remain attached and eyes remain readable
neck overlap remains concealed without exposed plates or gaps
stable shoulders, elbows, hips and short hindlimbs
soft grouped paws curl toward the observed palm without sharp underside pinching
opposing thumbs and separately animated digits are not required
tail remains attached without abrupt root stretching in reviewed motion
